limits: Affected rule only, evaluated on carried exact-scope baseline DB with two dev build-error tests excluded. Preserves alias names; locationless alias instances link to their actual type-name use, not an inferred alias definition. Full candidate suite remains separate.
comparison: Primary URI/base/region, rule ID and partial fingerprints are compared as a multiset, excluding artifact indices. Alias/message descriptions are compared after removing link IDs and duplicate merged lines. Two merged messages expand because restored locations distinguish link targets.
